theater: 河北河間府南境邊堡寨

battle.name: 邊堡寨之戰
battle.theater: 河北河間府南境邊堡寨
battle.brief: 貞祐元年冬，蒙古木華黎部南征河北，連下洺州、廣平諸郡，直逼河間。金將完顏陳和尚率步卒五千，據河北邊境邊堡寨固守，以強弩當蒙古精騎，數月不能拔寨，蒙古軍遂退。此役中弩取代長弓成為寨牆防線骨幹，是金朝在平原邊防以步制騎的罕見成功。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 邊堡寨之戰是1211年蒙古第一次大舉南侵期間，金朝與蒙古軍在河北南部河間府境內的一場邊寨攻防戰。交戰一方是完顏氏建立的金朝。宣宗完顏樹於貞祐元年即位，北方防務分由中都路、河東路與河北各路承擔，邊境寨堡多由簽軍與漢人戍卒輪守，樞密院直轄的精騎則集結於中都、山東一線待命，地方義軍尚未成軍。金軍的戰力結構是步騎混編：以長槊、刀、盾為主的步兵守在寨內核心，弩手配置在牆垛與壕溝之後，騎兵的任務是封鎖寨外通道、遮斷糧道，而不是與蒙古騎兵在原野上對撞。交戰的另一方是成吉思汗的蒙古帝國。1211年滅遼之後，汗廷分兵兩路，成吉思汗自率大軍西向進取西夏與關中，木華黎則率騎兵經略河東、河北，靠遊騎與哨探尋找突擊邊寨和切斷補給的機會。因此這場戰役不是兩軍主力的正面會合，而是蒙古騎兵在運動戰中啃下一處金朝邊防堡壘的典型戰例，也構成金朝在北方邊防崩解前少數站得住的據點之一。
countriesEn: The Battle of the Bianbao stockade was a defence of a frontier fort fought in the territory of Hejian prefecture in southern Hebei, during the first great Mongol invasion of the Jin dynasty in 1211. One side was the Jin dynasty founded by the Wanyan clan. Emperor Xuanzong Wanyan Shu had taken the throne in the first year of the Zhenyou era, and the northern defence was divided among the Zhongdu circuit, the Hedong circuit and the various Hebei circuits; border stockades were mostly garrisoned by qianjun levies and Han soldiers in rotation, while the elite cavalry directly under the Privy Council was concentrated around Zhongdu and in Shandong, and no organised provincial militia existed yet. The Jin army was a mixed force of foot and horse: spearmen, swordsmen and shield-bearers formed the core inside the fort, crossbowmen were posted behind the parapets and the ditch, and the cavalry were used to seal the roads outside the walls and to cut supplies rather than to meet Mongol riders in open field. The other side was the Mongol empire of Chinggis Khan. After the destruction of the Liao in 1211 the court divided its forces: Chinggis Khan himself led the main army west towards the Western Xia and Guanzhong, while Mugali took mounted columns into Hedong and Hebei, using mobile raiding parties and scouts to find openings for sudden attacks on border forts and for the disruption of supply lines. The battle was therefore not a set-piece clash of the two main armies but a typical instance of Mongol cavalry trying to chew through one Jin frontier fort during a war of movement, and it was one of the few positions the Jin could still hold before the northern frontier system collapsed.
people: 守方指揮官完顏陳和尚，是此役唯一留下詳細記載的人。他本姓王，出仕金朝，貞祐元年蒙古兵南下、河北諸郡相繼告急時，他奉命率部眾前往河北邊境，據邊堡寨以拒敵。陳和尚募得步卒約五千人，據寨固守，所面對的是蒙古軍的精騎。他治軍嚴整，出戰之前必令士卒休息整備才許出列，屢次乘夜開寨襲擊蒙古營壘，使敵不得解甲安眠；他的部下是金朝北方軍中少數敢於在寨外與蒙古騎兵周旋的隊伍。守方最高層是金宣宗完顏樹，他在中都聞報之後派使馳至寨中，賜衣物與金牌，並擢升陳和尚的官職，以示激勵；關於完顏陳和尚之名與日後賜姓的說法，各家記載互有異詞，但可以確定的是，金廷有意以宗室名號與榮譽把邊軍將領留在河北。蒙古方面的指揮層，以經略河北的木華黎為主，其下有帖木哥等部將率騎眾攻城；蒙古各部將領互不統屬，遇堅寨久攻不下時往往各自退兵散去，這是蒙古早期攻城戰的一個特徵。陳和尚其後輾轉於河北、河東之間，1232年與完顏合達、移剌蒲阿等同僚率金朝精兵參戰三峰山，兵敗被殺，英名與悲願一同落幕。
peopleEn: The commander on the defensive side, Wanyan Chengheshang, is the only man for whom this battle is recorded in any detail. He was born into the Wang clan and served the Jin; when the Mongols came south in the first year of Zhenyou and the Hebei prefectures fell one after another, he was sent with troops to the Hebei frontier and took up position in the Bianbao stockade. Chengheshang gathered about five thousand infantry and held the fort, and what faced him was the picked cavalry of the Mongol army. He drilled his men strictly, always ordering them to rest and refit before they were allowed to leave the walls, and he repeatedly opened the gates at night to strike the Mongol camp so that the enemy never got the chance to take off its armour and sleep soundly; his command was one of the few units in the Jin northern armies willing to operate outside the walls against Mongol riders. At the top of the defensive command sat Emperor Xuanzong Wanyan Shu, who, on hearing the report at Zhongdu, sent envoys to the fort with clothing and a gold tally and promoted Chengheshang in rank; accounts differ on the question of his surname and the later bestowal of the Wanyan name, but what is certain is that the court wanted to bind frontier commanders to the north through honour and the prestige of the imperial clan. On the Mongol side the command was led by Mugali, who took charge of Hebei, with commanders such as Timuge leading the mounted assault; Mongol leaders were not subordinated to one another and, when a stubborn fort resisted a long siege, individual columns often simply withdrew, a characteristic of early Mongol siege warfare. Chengheshang afterwards served in Hebei and Hedong, and in 1232 he fought at Sanfengshan alongside Wanyan Heda and Yilie Pu-a, commanding Jin elite troops; the army was destroyed and he was killed, and his fame and his loyalty ended together in that defeat.
kits: 此役最能代表守方裝備的，是弩。卡面所標的十字弩屬歐洲弩系，而金朝寨中所用的是中國的蹶張弩一類手拉弩，兩者同屬弩這個技術家族，機制相通：以人力拉弦蓄勢，上弦後短暫發射，無須在射手身上長期保持拉力；差別在形制、配備與消耗，不在射擊原理。守寨之際，弩手把弩架在牆垛後或壕溝邊的射位上，張弦、瞄定、擊發、再裝填分班輪轉，把一條條通往寨門的通道用箭雨封住；卡面那句城牆上它比長弓可靠，講的正是這個道理：長弓的力道靠射手雙臂長時間維持，久射即疲，弩則把這份力氣一次交給機械。蒙古騎兵方面的核心裝備是角木複合的反曲弓，拉力大、箭速快，騎在馬上便能射擊，這是草原騎兵的基本功；蒙古兵另備彎刀與長矛，多為札甲、皮甲一類的輕重適中護具，鎖子甲在當時並不普遍。攻城之際，蒙古人用撞車、雲梯，並常驅使被俘的降兵填壕拔寨，把騎兵最靈活的攻勢轉為地面上的強攻。蒙古出遠征時按人攜帶數匹馬，分騎乘、備用與載糧之用，並以氈帳、風乾牛肉與乳製品隨軍；後勤上依靠的是草原的牲畜與隨行的羊群。金朝一方同期也在擴充城防器械，貞祐年間造出的飛天夜叉擲這類投擲火器，同樣是為了在寨牆後面補上火力。
kitsEn: The weapon that best stands for the defence in this battle is the crossbow. The crossbow shown on the card belongs to the European branch of the family, while what the Jin used in the stockade was the Chinese hand-drawn crossbow of the zhang-type; both belong to the same technological family, sharing the same principle: the string is drawn and stored by muscle power and released in a single shot, so the archer never has to hold the draw. The difference lies in form, equipment and supply, not in how the shot is made. During the siege the crossbowmen rested their weapons on firing platforms behind the parapets or along the ditch, taking turns in the cycle of cocking, aiming, loosing and reloading, so that the lanes leading to the gate were sealed with a shower of bolts. The card's remark that on a wall it is more reliable than the longbow says exactly this: a longbow demands that the archer hold the full draw for a long time and tires quickly, while the crossbow hands that effort over to the machine once and for all. The core Mongol equipment was the composite recurved bow of horn and wood, strong and fast in the arrow, capable of being used from the saddle, which was the basic skill of steppe cavalry; the Mongols also carried curved sabres and long spears, and wore armour of the lamellar and leather sort, with mail being uncommon at that time. In assault they used battering rams and scaling ladders, and repeatedly drove captive troops into the ditch and up the walls, converting the cavalry's most flexible offensive into a grinding ground assault. On campaign the Mongols carried several horses apiece, for riding, for replacement and for carrying grain, together with felt tents, wind-dried beef and dairy foods, their logistics resting on the herds of the steppe and the flocks driven along with them. The Jin were likewise expanding their fortification equipment at this time; thrown incendiary devices of the Flying Night-Watchman type produced in the Zhenyou years were made for exactly the same purpose, to add firepower behind the wall.
tactics: 蒙古方面的攻城邏輯是先以遊騎掃清外圍的據點與村落，遮斷寨內的糧水，再行合圍；合圍之後未必立刻猛攻，而是輪番挑釁、逼守軍出寨消耗，把蒙古騎兵的速度優勢用在切割補給上。真正攻城時，騎兵必須下馬或倚騎而射，密集的寨牆、拒馬與壕溝正好抵銷其機動性；蒙軍常以被俘降兵為先鋒填壕，再將本部推上，攻城因此變成傷亡極大的消耗戰。守方金軍的部署以寨牆為核心，弩手分班輪射，專射接近牆根的騎兵與雲梯，長槊手與刀手則貼近女牆，準備在缺口處與登寨者短兵相接；糧食靠寨中存糧與河間方向的補給維持。陳和尚所部最突出的一手是夜襲：他屢次開寨出擊，燒燬蒙古營中的帳幕與積貯，使圍城者不得安眠，反覆消耗其馬匹與體力，延緩合圍。蒙古軍最後退兵，與其說是被正面擊退，不如說是冬季的河北平原草料不繼、糧道越拉越長，加上久攻不下的折損，使進攻本身難以為繼。
tacticsEn: The Mongol method of assault was to clear the surrounding posts and villages with mobile raiding columns, cut the fort off from grain and water, and only then close in; once encircled they did not always attack at once but harassed in turns, provoking the defenders out of the fort to wear them down, and turned the speed of the cavalry to the task of severing supply. When they did storm the position, the riders had to dismount or shoot from the saddle, and dense walls, caltrops and ditches cancelled out that mobility; the Mongols regularly used captured men as pioneers to fill the ditch and then pressed their own troops forward, which turned the assault into a slaughter of the most costly kind. The Jin defence was built around the wall: crossbowmen fired in shifts, concentrating on the riders who came close to the base of the rampart and on the scaling ladders, while spearmen and swordsmen stayed behind the parapet ready for close fighting where a breach opened. Grain was kept in the fort and replenished from the direction of Hejian. The outstanding move of Chengheshang's command was the night sortie: it opened the gates again and again to burn the Mongol tents and stores so that the besiegers could not sleep, wearing down their horses and their nerve and slowing the tightening of the noose. The final Mongol withdrawal was better described as a withdrawal than a defeat in the open: winter grazing in the Hebei plain ran short, the supply line grew longer and longer, and the losses of a fruitless siege made the offensive impossible to sustain.
data: 兵員方面，史籍記載守軍為步卒約五千人，皆為步卒而無成建制的騎兵可倚；蒙古方面投入的則是數萬騎兵，木華黎所部總兵力當遠不止此數，故此役守軍實際是以五對數萬的比例作戰。相持時間，主流記載作數月，有說百餘日，較可信的說法是自十月入冬至十二月之間，蒙古軍始終未能拔寨。距離上，邊堡寨在河間府治南面不足二百里，在衡水城東南約百餘里，扼的是衡水通向河間、大名的一條通道。器械數據只能作概數：蹶張弩的有效射程約在百五十步至二百步上下，蒙古的反曲弓射程亦大致相若，但箭速較慢、精度較高的是弩；寨牆高數丈，壕溝外再加拒馬與鹿角，牆頭可容弩手分列。糧食數字無從確算，五千守軍要撐數月，全賴寨中存糧與河間方向的接應，而蒙古正是靠切斷這一條補給線才有攻寨的可能。損失方面，各家史籍都說蒙古攻寨折損甚重，卻都沒有留下可核的數目。放在大戰局看，1211年十月至十二月，蒙古連下洺州、廣平、邢州、滄州等郡，十二月太原陷落；1213年蒙古再度南下，1214年宣宗遷都汴京；1232年三峰山，金朝一萬精兵全軍覆沒；金朝於1234年亡。
dataEn: On strength, the historical record gives the garrison as about five thousand infantry, foot soldiers with no formed cavalry to fall back on, while the Mongols brought in tens of thousands of riders; the force under Mugali was far larger than that, so in effect five men stood against tens of thousands. As for duration, the usual account is a siege of several months, some sources saying more than a hundred days; the more defensible reading is that it ran from October into December, and the fort was never taken. In terms of distance, the Bianbao stockade lay a little under two hundred li south of the seat of Hejian prefecture and a little over a hundred li south-east of Hengshui, holding the road that runs from Hengshui to Hejian and Daming. Only approximations are possible for the hardware: the effective range of a Chinese crossbow was roughly a hundred and fifty to two hundred paces, and the Mongol recurved bow had a comparable reach, but the crossbow was slower in the arrow and more accurate; the wall stood several zhang high, with a ditch outside it reinforced by caltrops and abatis, and the parapet could hold crossbowmen in line. No reliable figure exists for grain: five thousand men needed several months of supply, and that came entirely from stores inside the fort and from the direction of Hejian, which is precisely why cutting that one line of supply was what made the siege possible at all. On losses, every account agrees that the Mongols lost heavily before the fort but none gives a figure that can be checked. Placed in the larger frame: between October and December 1211 the Mongols took the prefectures of Ming, Guangping, Xing and Cang, and Taiyuan fell in December; in 1213 the Mongols came south again, and in 1214 Xuanzong moved the capital to Bianjing; in 1232 the ten thousand elite soldiers of the Jin were annihilated at Sanfengshan; the Jin dynasty ended in 1234.
cause: 這場戰爭的遠因是成吉思汗在1211年滅遼之後把矛頭轉向金朝，兩家原本並無接壤，自1211年秋季起蒙古軍第一次大舉南下。直接引戰的說法，金元兩代史籍都提到金朝邊吏扣殺蒙古使者之事，成吉思汗以此為口實出兵；也有說法認為起兵本無關使者，而純粹出於汗廷要掃平金朝、取得牧地與人口的戰略考慮。就形勢而言，河北沿邊的寨堡體系是蒙古必須撬開的第一道關節：蒙古騎兵深入平原需要糧秣與牧場，河北的熟地與村落正是最方便的補給來源，而邊堡寨正好卡在衡水與河間之間的往來通道上。金朝自身的處境更為尷尬。宣宗完顏樹剛剛即位，朝中正在爭論是否南遷，北方精兵集中於中都與河東一線，河北沿線多只剩簽軍與老弱駐守，各路彼此不相屬， 命令常常到不了寨堡。蒙古木華黎部就是看準了這一段空隙，以遊騎掃清外圍、逐點啃掉孤立據點，最終把矛頭指向了守著五千步卒的邊堡寨。
causeEn: The distant cause of the war was that Chinggis Khan, after destroying the Liao in 1211, turned his spearhead against the Jin; the two states had not even been neighbours, and from the autumn of 1211 the Mongols came south in force for the first time. The immediate trigger, as both Jin and Yuan histories relate, was the detention and killing of Mongol envoys by Jin frontier officials, which Chinggis Khan used as his justification; other readings hold that no envoys were involved at all and that the campaign was purely the product of the khan's strategic wish to crush the Jin and take its pastures and people. In terms of circumstance, the chain of fortified stockades along the Hebei border was the first joint the Mongols had to prise open: their cavalry needed grain, fodder and pastures once it penetrated the plains, and the cultivated fields and villages of Hebei were the most convenient source of supply, while the Bianbao stockade sat directly on the road of communication between Hengshui and Hejian. The Jin's own position was more awkward. Xuanzong Wanyan Shu had only just taken the throne, the court was already arguing over whether to move the capital south, the northern elite was concentrated in a line at Zhongdu and Hedong, and what remained along the Hebei frontier was mostly qianjun levies and old and infirm garrisons, with commands that often failed to reach the outlying forts at all. It was precisely this gap that Mugali's columns aimed at: clearing the perimeter with mobile raiding parties, picking off isolated posts one at a time, until the spearhead came to rest on a stockade held by five thousand foot soldiers.
impact: 守寨成功在金廷上下引起的震動超出戰役本身。宣宗派使賜物、擢升陳和尚，一時河北邊軍以為北方尚可為守，弩兵與寨牆的價值被重新評估；此役也讓蒙古方面明白，平原上可以隨意驅逐的金朝散兵，一旦被收攏進寨牆與壕溝之間，就成了難以強攻的硬骨頭。此後金朝在城防器械上用力，投擲火器如飛天夜叉擲正是在此思路下出現，用火藥與鐵殼補上守軍的火力缺口，與弩兵構成同一套城防邏輯。然而一場堡寨的堅守改變不了河北的整體局勢。1213年蒙古再度南下，河北諸郡相繼淪陷，1214年宣宗遷都汴京，河北自此歸入蒙古統治；原先的官軍寨堡多淪為空殼，河北抗蒙義軍在張柔、苗道潤、高仙妞等部之後接續興起，以山寨為據點與蒙古騎兵周旋，邊寨體系由官軍接力換成義軍接力。陳和尚本人則在1232年三峰山率金朝精兵迎戰蒙古軍，與完顏合達、移剌蒲阿等同僚一併戰死，金朝賴以立國的精銳步兵在那一日耗盡；邊堡寨之守與三峰山之歿，前後兩件事於是把金朝北防的全部得失寫在同一個人身上。
impactEn: The successful defence of the stockade shook the Jin court far beyond the battle itself. Xuanzong sent envoys with gifts and promoted Chengheshang; for a time the northern frontier troops of Hebei believed the north might still be held, and the value of crossbowmen behind walls was re-evaluated. The battle also taught the Mongols that Jin soldiers who could be chased across the plains at will became stubborn adversaries once they were gathered between a rampart and a ditch. The Jin accordingly pushed harder on fortification equipment, and thrown incendiary devices such as the Flying Night-Watchman appeared in this line of thinking, adding firepower behind the wall with gunpowder and iron shells to complement the crossbowmen and forming part of the same defensive logic. Yet no single stockade could turn the situation of Hebei around. The Mongols came south again in 1213, the Hebei prefectures fell one after another, and in 1214 Xuanzong moved the capital to Bianjing, leaving Hebei under Mongol rule; the old official strongholds stood empty, and anti-Mongol militias rose in their place, under leaders such as Zhang Rou, Miao Daorun and Gao Xianiu, fighting the Mongol cavalry from their own hill forts. The frontier system of stockades passed from one relay of defenders to the next. Chengheshang himself fought at Sanfengshan in 1232, leading Jin elite infantry against the Mongols and dying there alongside Wanyan Heda and Yilie Pu-a; the elite infantry on which the Jin had founded itself was spent in a single day. The defence of the stockade and the death at Sanfengshan thus wrote the whole record of the Jin northern defence onto one man.
result: 結局是蒙古軍未能攻下邊堡寨。陳和尚以五千步卒據寨相守數月，蒙古騎兵繞寨攻之不能下，終於退兵。退兵的原因各家記載不一：或謂糧秣不濟、遊騎無法久駐，或謂攻寨折損太重，或謂蒙古主將在攻勢中陣亡；這些說法都出自事後追述，無一能被證實，比較可以肯定的是，此役蒙古沒有贏得攻城，卻也沒有被正面擊潰，只是把力量撤回南下的序列中。金軍守住了邊堡寨，但也沒有能力反擊或收復失地，河北的局勢依然整體向蒙古傾斜。從戰史的長線看，邊堡寨之戰因此有兩重意義：對金朝而言，它是北方邊防體系瓦解前少數站得住的堡壘之一，證明了以寨牆、壕溝與弩兵對付蒙古高機動騎兵的可行性；對蒙古而言，它則是一次成本高昂而沒有收益的攻堅，提示汗廷在河北必須改換攻城的方式，而金廷在宣宗朝往後把大量精力放在城防與義軍上，也正是從這一類教訓裡來的。
resultEn: The outcome was that the Mongol army failed to take the Bianbao stockade. Chengheshang held the fort with five thousand infantry for several months; the Mongol cavalry rode around it and could not take it, and at last withdrew. The accounts of why they withdrew differ: some say grain and fodder ran short and the raiding columns could not stay long in place, some say the losses before the walls were too heavy, some say a Mongol commander was killed during the assault. All of these are after-the-fact reconstructions and none can be confirmed. What can be said with more confidence is that the Mongols did not win the siege, yet were not beaten in the open either; they simply withdrew their strength back into the southern campaign. The Jin held the stockade, but they had the strength neither to counterattack nor to recover the lost ground, and the situation in Hebei still tilted overall towards the Mongols. In the long run of military history the battle carries two meanings. For the Jin it was one of the few positions that still stood before the northern frontier system fell apart, and it demonstrated that a rampart, a ditch and a body of crossbowmen could answer the highly mobile Mongol cavalry. For the Mongols it was a costly assault with no gain, a reminder to the khan's court that the siege of Hebei had to be conducted by different means. And the attention the Jin court at Xuanzong's court afterwards paid to fortification and to the militias grew precisely out of lessons of this kind.
